summary: This is an 8-K filing by Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc. (IIPR) reporting a $20 million secured term loan obtained by its indirect subsidiary IIP-IL 2 LLC from Generations Bank on April 24, 2026. The note bears 9% fixed interest, with interest-only payments for the first year, then amortizing over 20 years with a balloon at maturity on April 22, 2029. The loan is secured by mortgages on Illinois properties and assignments of leases and rents, with IIP as guarantor. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
